x.translation:
I¹ ported my Mini web browser to Rust & Swift. It's faster, more secure, and shockingly, nicer to iterate on than Electron + Bun.

I always wanted Safari-like UX but… Chrome 😁. Thanks to the 𝚌𝚎𝚏 crate, I can bundle up-to-date Chromium.

𝚏𝚡 𝚊𝚌𝚙 lets me embed an agent without bloating the app. It talks to my local fx CLI over ACP. fx can then manage the browser via an MCP server².

By ditching Electron, I was able to get Liquid Glass, faster boots, and a more Mac-native feeling. Little things like fine-grained focus and input control, which are nightmare fuel in JS, just work®.

Native is the future, both on the desktop and in the cloud. I suspect the entire software world will "nativify" faster than people realize, as DHH hinted at Rails World. Excited that Vercel's bet on Fluid will help support this, whether you choose to go Rust, Go, Zig, scriptc…

¹ Built on https://t.co/OL0LzGsXKY with Opus 5.5 and Sol 6
² In the process I learned about https://t.co/sJoQWFreGF, which I'm now really excited about. This will allow a more secure and direct way to expose MCP tools

There's a thread going viral about a 'perf improvement' attributed to a compiler change. I want AI in the service of understanding the universe and enhancing human cognition and creativity.

x.author: Aaron Levie
x.role: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
x.summary: Box CEO Aaron Levie 近期深入剖析了 AI Agent 对经济结构的重塑作用，以及企业级 AI 落地中评估体系（Evals）的核心地位。他指出，Agent 将通过消除摩擦力重构市场，而企业若想实现 AI 规模化，必须建立起针对非确定性流程的评估机制。
x.translation:
【推文 1】思考一个由 Agent 为用户做出最优或最高效选择的世界，其影响深远。一方面，部分经济领域受益于客户改变习惯时的传统摩擦力；在这些市场中，转换成本将大幅降低，竞争将剧烈加剧，直到颠覆性方案与现有巨头达成平衡。另一方面，许多市场因过高的摩擦力而受损，Agent 将通过简化购买流程，释放此前难以触达的经济活动，如医疗、旅游、本地服务及新兴信息服务等，都将成为 Agent 的净受益者。无论如何，一个由 Agent 为我们目标不懈工作的未来，注定与今天截然不同，这将会非常疯狂。

【推文 2】无法衡量就无法自动化。这意味着评估（Evals）是 AI 在企业中普及的关键门槛。我们可以通过软件测试确定性流程，但大多数企业尚无有效手段理解其非确定性流程（特别是 Agent 执行的工作）的运作现状。对于采用 AI 的企业而言，评估是任务关键型的，因为若不了解 Agent 在当前环境下的表现，就无法判断哪些有效、哪些故障、哪些改进了。所有的变更、升级和部署都依赖于高质量的评估。随着时间推移，不仅实验室和行业内会出现更多领域特定的评估工具，每个企业也都需要清晰掌握 Agent 在自身环境中的表现。这是一个巨大的机遇。
x.recommendation: Levie 的观点揭示了 AI 商业化的深层逻辑：从“效率工具”向“决策代理”的范式转移。对于 AI 从业者，这提醒我们关注 Agent 带来的市场摩擦力消除效应，并意识到‘评估体系’（Evals）将是未来企业级 AI 竞争的护城河，而非仅仅是模型性能本身。

Interesting to think about all the implications in a world where agents begin to make the best or most efficient choice for their users.

On one hand, there is some subset of the economy that benefits from the friction customers traditionally have changing something about their habits. In those parts of the market, switching costs will come down and competition is going to increase dramatically until some equilibrium is reached between the disruptive alternatives and the incumbents.

On the other hand, there are lots of markets that are hurt by a significant amount of friction, where agents will begin to unlock all kinds of economic activity by making it far easier to buy products or services that were too frictionful before. Healthcare, travel, local services, certain information services, and other entirely new markets probably are net beneficiaries of agents as a result.

No matter what, a future meaningfully mediated by agents that work tirelessly for us and our goals can’t possibly function exactly the same as today. Going to be wild.

You can’t automate what you can’t measure. This means that evals are one of the gates to diffusion of AI in the enterprise. 

We can test our deterministic processes through software, but most enterprises have no useful way of understanding how their non-deterministic processes are working today. Specifically the work that agents are doing for them.

Evals are mission critical for enterprises adopting AI because you have no other way of knowing what’s working, what’s broken, what changed, what improved, what you can do more of, etc. if you don’t have a good sense of how agents work in your environment today. All changes, upgrades, and deployments are downstream from good evals.

Not only are we going to get vastly more domain specific evals over time for the labs and across the industry, but every enterprise will also need a clear sense of how agents are performing in their environment as well. Huge opportunity.

podcasts.summary: 本期播客聚焦 AI 时代的“隐形基石”——数据基础设施。VAST Data 创始人 Renen Hallak 指出，AI 革命不仅是算力竞赛，更是数据吞吐能力的博弈。核心 Takeaway：AI 时代的“工厂”需要全新的操作系统，即能够支撑超高密度算力、处理非结构化数据并提供极速访问的软件基础设施层。反直觉洞见在于，数据需求增长呈指数级爆发（如客户从 500PB 需求激增至 2.5EB），传统的存储架构已完全无法满足现代 AI 对海量图片、视频及多模态数据的实时喂养需求。精彩金句：“我们正在构建新时代的操作系统，它不仅是存储，更是让 AI 能够理解并处理海量数据的核心引擎。”
podcasts.translation: Matt Turck 与 VAST Data CEO Renen Hallak 探讨了 NVIDIA “五层蛋糕”模型中的中间层。Hallak 解释道，AI 工厂与传统数据中心有着本质区别：从 10kW 提升至 500kW 的机架功率密度，从 CPU 转向 GPU，以及从处理结构化数据转向处理海量非结构化数据。VAST Data 的角色是作为这一层的“操作系统”，通过软硬件协同，确保 GPU 能够以极低延迟获取海量数据，从而支撑起从模型训练到智能体推理的复杂任务。
podcasts.recommendation: 如果你想跳过模型层面的炒作，深入理解 AI 硬件背后的“喂养”机制，本期节目是必听课。它揭示了支撑 xAI 等顶尖 AI 玩家背后的基础设施逻辑，非常适合关注 AI 算力基建与企业级架构的专业人士。
